name: The Champion
description: The hero of The Theriad who defended the shrine to Karametra.

description_citations.text: Magic 2015: card flavor text (Magic 2015, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion and the philosopher Olexa went to the opposing camp and the enemy broke the siege.
timeline.quote: Behind them, the enemy raised sail and departed, breaking the siege.

citation.text: Traveling Philosopher (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion and companions pass through a forest of stacked stones.
timeline.quote: On the fourth day they passed through a forest of immense stacked stones.

citation.text: Silent Artisan (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Brygus the sentry was found dead and the Champion's supplies stolen.
timeline.quote: At sunrise, the Champion and her companions awoke to find their supplies gone and Brygus, their sentry, dead.

citation.text: Triton Shorethief (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion met Thyrogog of the Ashlands, who charged with Goremaster.
timeline.quote: The foul minotaur raised the great axe called Goremaster and charged.

citation.text: Felhide Minotaur (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion counted eight graves after a victory over the forces of Mogis.

citation.text: Borderland Minotaur (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion stood alone between the Returned and the shrine to Karametra until temple guardians awoke.
timeline.quote: The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra

citation.text: Bronze Sable (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion lays down her weapons and approaches the great hart, which bows to her, marking her as the Chosen of the Sun God.
timeline.quote: The hart, sacred to Heliod and bathed in the god's own light, bowed to the Champion, marking her as the Chosen of the Sun God.

citation.text: Great Hart (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion faces a cyclops with a single spear, reasoning that it has but one eye, while young Althemone doubts her.
timeline.quote: The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."

citation.text: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As a girl, the future Champion of the Sun is taught by a centaur to make peace with her anger.
timeline.quote: "I will teach you the ways of war, child. But first you must make peace with yourself."

citation.text: Swordwise Centaur (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spends months among the leonin of Oreskos.
timeline.quote: After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spent many months among the leonin of Oreskos.

citation.text: Oreskos Swiftclaw (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A rotted hulk rises from the sea and looms over the Champion, with the bodies of Kaliaros and Photine pinned beneath it.
timeline.quote: The hulk rose from the sea and loomed over the Champion.

citation.text: Rotted Hulk (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Champion and her companions arrive after a battle to find a solitary minotaur amid the carnage.
timeline.quote: The Champion and her companions marched through the night, but the battle was over before they arrived.

citation.text: Pensive Minotaur (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lanathos tells the leonin the tale of Polukranos and the Champion of the Sun, who slays the hydra at the Plateau of the Four Winds.
timeline.quote: Polukranos, eater of poleis, beloved of the gods, was no more.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Lanathos explains that the Champion of the Sun is a title, and that the latest champion killed Polukranos about a month ago.
timeline.quote: Very recently. During the Silence of the gods. A month ago, perhaps slightly more.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

relations.note: Karametra awakened temple guardians to aid the Champion.
relations.quote: She would have been overcome if not for the aid of the temple guardians whom Karametra awakened.

citation.text: Bronze Sable (Magic 2015, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: In the story the Champion kills Polukranos.
relations.quote: All that remained on the silent plateau was the Champion of Heliod, her spear shining in the sunlight.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

pages_say.description: Heroine of the Theriad who fights monsters, honors the gods and speaks to enemies.

citation.text: Theros: card flavor text (Theros, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The hero of The Theriad, chosen by Heliod's sacred hart, who fought a cyclops and trained with a centaur.

citation.text: Born of the Gods: card flavor text (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Journey into Nyx: card flavor text (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: Magic 2015: card flavor text (Magic 2015, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A title Heliod gives a worthy mortal in times of great need; the latest champion slew Polukranos near Meletis.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

pages_say.description: A hero who defended the shrine of Karametra, per The Theriad.

citation.text: Conspiracy: Take the Crown: card flavor text (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A hero who reached for a stone while Heliod placed the sun in her hand.
